title: In-batch concept co-occurrence not loss design creates dense alignment
strongest_attack: Noun-overlap curation is hard-negative mining (NegCLIP/JEST); retrieval won't stay equal and a CLIP-small null is excused by scale
shutting_up_experiment: Three arms at CLIP-B/32: random vs noun-overlap-curated vs hardness-matched control (matched in-batch similarity without co-occurrence); dose-response sweep; joint retrieval+dense metrics; >=3 seeds
reason: Causal training lever with a runnable control that isolates co-occurrence from generic hardness; free-to-deploy implication

title: Text-batch rehearsal works by gradient rebalancing not by content
strongest_attack: Gradient-scale matching is underdefined; pseudo-rehearsal is Robins 1995; likely outcome is the mushy middle (fluency kept, knowledge lost)
shutting_up_experiment: Five rehearsal arms {none,curated,random web text,shuffled tokens,repeated doc} at fixed token budget; pre-registered capability-stratified eval; two matching conventions reported
reason: Cheap decisive design; even the partial outcome is a quantified cost-cutting recipe for rehearsal-data curation

title: Dimensional collapse doesn't hurt transfer
strongest_attack: Analysis-only: RankMe claims prediction not causation and regularizers are justified by end-task gains, so no metric/method/workflow depends on the causal claim; intervention hits projector rank while transfer reads backbone features; 'except extreme collapse' is an escape hatch
reason: No outcome changes any decision; the only rescue (showing RankMe-guided selection misleads) is expected to fail against RankMe's own validation

title: Generative editing enables causal measurement of context reliance in segmentation
strongest_attack: The instrument may measure the editor not the scene: edit artifacts are worst-case for dense models and removal edits substitute the generator's context prior; score may be editor-dependent
shutting_up_experiment: Null-edit artifact calibration + cross-editor invariance (>=2 systems) + real-photo anchor (video frames with objects naturally entering/leaving static scenes); then 100+ classes x 3 datasets with frequency/scale partialled out
reason: Causal input-level instrument with a physical validation path; per-class actionable output (context-decorrelation training targets)

title: Uncertainty sampling selects LLM-annotator failures; decorrelated acquisition fixes it (M6)
strongest_attack: Why do AL at all - LLM labels are cheap so annotate-everything makes acquisition order irrelevant; the error predictor is circular without ground truth
shutting_up_experiment: Binding-budget settings (VLM dense annotation, frontier-model labels at scale); direct uncertainty-error correlation on ground-truthed pools; acquisition arms at matched total cost incl. annotate-everything + noise-robust training baseline; predictor = annotator self-consistency
reason: Mechanism + lever (acquisition function) + cheap decisive first measurement; every branch including the premise-killing one yields deployable advice

title: Multi-task pretraining's benefit is the data not the tasks
strongest_attack: Pooled-image control unconstructible at claim scale (per-task labels don't exist on pooled images; pseudo-labels smuggle in a teacher); compute-matching is an unwinnable war
shutting_up_experiment: Exact control on fully multi-labeled corpora (COCO multi-annotation, Hypersim); arms {multi-task pooled, single-task pooled, single-task own}; two compute conventions side by side; two-point scale sweep
reason: Arm assignment is a genuine causal lever; the decomposition number doesn't exist at any scale and prices the labels-vs-images investment decision

title: The many ADE20Ks: split drift breaks cross-paper comparability
strongest_attack: Purest audit-without-lever: no hypothesis at risk, no decision changes; attribution needs a within-framework factorial that dissolves the headline into piecemeal protocol ablations
reason: No experimental risk means no experiment can save it; salvage the fixed-checkpoint harness as shared eval infrastructure for C-0310/C-0302

title: Last-layer group-robustness fixes fail on spatially entangled bias
strongest_attack: Refuting an unclaimed extension (nobody said DFR works for dense) with a 100%-correlation cartoon confound; constructive arm is a hyperparameter sweep
shutting_up_experiment: Dissociation design: identical images + planted correlation, classification head vs dense head under DFR - outcome genuinely open; correlation-strength dial; one natural-bias dataset; retraining-depth curve yielding a transferable debiasing-depth quantity
reason: The dissociation not the failure is the finding; controlled causal levers (bias strength, retraining depth) and a practitioner-usable deliverable

title: The camera ISP is a bigger domain axis than the weather
strongest_attack: Apples-to-oranges headline: both ISP and weather ranges are author-chosen so either axis can win; RAW+dense-label data may not exist; Rawgment (CVPR 2023) part-owns the augmentation arm
shutting_up_experiment: Real-distribution anchoring: same RAW frames through N actual pipelines (dcraw/phone SDK/automotive ISP) vs real paired weather (ACDC); labels annotated once per RAW frame, exactly invariant across renders; ISP-randomization training arm with Rawgment baseline
reason: True intervention with label-invariant treatment; falsifiable once anchored to real device distributions; redirects real robustness-engineering budgets either way

title: Mild shifts compound super-linearly
strongest_attack: Super-linearity is a units artifact (bounded metrics can't compose additively by arithmetic; additive-vs-multiplicative interaction trap has no principled resolution); likely null is worthless; exciting outcome only says 'benchmarks should compose'
reason: Frozen-model audit with no causal lever; the rescue (pre-registered form + mechanistic training interventions) is a different training-heavy paper nobody proposed

title: Does accuracy-on-the-line survive dense prediction
strongest_attack: Scope-test audit on an inadequate model panel (~30 correlated segmenters vs Miller's hundreds); nonlinearity is plausibly Jensen's-inequality arithmetic of mIoU aggregation; RCA (Valindria 2017) already serves the per-image OOD-quality-estimation use case
reason: Neither outcome changes a decision; the only rescue (a working corrected OOD-mIoU estimator) is a different paper of unknown feasibility

title: Orthogonal-classifier + resolution-matched audit of OV-seg text towers (M1)
strongest_attack: Target claim not load-bearing: text towers are an open-set interface not a seen-class booster; both outcomes are nulls (collapse = assumption confirmed; recovery = answered by 'a new class costs one embedding'); Hoffer 2018 control transplant
reason: No experiment fixes a non-load-bearing target; the interesting cell (shuffled embeddings hurting) is an ablation row not a paper

title: Budget-matched post-hoc filter equivalence audit of attention surgery (M2)
strongest_attack: Low-stakes niche (training-free CLIP-seg has no deployment surface); NACLIP publishes the Gaussian prior as a method; equivalence needs TOST margins the power won't sustain; boundary metrics likely break the equivalence, vindicating the surgery papers
reason: Clean cheap design in service of a hygiene result for a micro-genre; kill on stakes

title: Directional asymmetry in VLM spatial reasoning tracks raster serialization (M3)
strongest_attack: Frozen audit can't control text-prior/image-statistics confounds on closed-data models; retrain arm has a permanent 'scale too small' escape hatch; lever aging out under 2D-RoPE/tiled encodings
reason: Closest call: the projector-only retrain design is elegant but the payoff caps at a footnote for a receding architecture cohort; revive only on free evidence from existing per-relation tables

title: Adam-moment transplant vs update rank in fine-tuning forgetting (M4)
strongest_attack: Plausibly LR hygiene in disguise: the preconditioner-mimicking LR arm is the transplant by another name and tuned warmup is standard (Biderman et al. controlled schedules); instructed-harsh crowded zone with quarterly scoop risk; expected result is a mushy fraction changing no method choice
reason: Even the rescuing shuffled-transplant control leaves a best case of revising a narrative's decomposition inside someone else's fast-moving literature

title: Post-hoc whitening audit across published SSL checkpoints (M5)
strongest_attack: Checkpoint zoo can't support attribution (data/epochs/arch/aug all vary); matched-recipe version is solo-learn's published territory with small gaps; transfer-set whitening is a distribution leak; SSL methods justify themselves by fine-tuning where probe whitening is irrelevant
reason: Both outcomes are dead ends; no experimental path to a decision-changing claim; easiest kill in the batch

title: Annotation-budget crossover predicted by feature-sharing score (M7)
strongest_attack: Crossover lives where nobody operates (head classes in diminishing returns at benchmark scale); the foundation-backbone predictor dissolves the from-scratch allocation question it predicts; simulated label markets map to no real decision
reason: Stranded between eras; the only rescue (real annotation domain, from-scratch constraints) is partnership-dependent and still succumbs to foundation-model penetration

title: Failure-mode-matched revival of classical priors (M8)
strongest_attack: A 3x4 grid can't establish a principle (~8/12 by common sense, self-graded rubric); effect budget inside evaluation noise post-CRF-decline (predicting signs of ~0.3 mIoU effects); dominated in practice by fine-tune/distill
reason: Scaling the grid fixes statistics not effect sizes; no realistic experiment makes small effects large
